problem: The function $g(p)={e}^{-4{p}^{2}}$ models the volume of gas that a vendor can sell, in liters, at a price of $p$ dollars per liter. Find the instantaneous rate at which the volume of gas is changing with respect to the price when $p=1.50$ dollars.

The function g(p)=e−4p2 models the volume of gas that a vendor can sell, in liters, at a price of p dollars per liter. Find the instantaneous rate at which the volume of gas is changing with respect to the price when p=1.50 dollars.

a
−9e−3 liters per dollar
b
−12e−9 liters per dollar
c
−10e liters per dollar
d
−8e−9 liters per dollar
e
−6e9 liters per dollar
